summary: Follow biological activity through an optical reporter and microscope to a recorded movie.
outcomes: Explain reporter kinetics, spatial sampling and optical noise.
Distinguish fluorescence, inferred events and electrical ground truth.
sequence: Observe a cell's synthetic fluorescence trace
Compare one-photon, two-photon, light-sheet and widefield concepts
Assess bleaching, motion, neuropil and phototoxicity

visual.question: Why does a fluorescence transient outlast the underlying activity?
visual.interaction: Vary synthetic reporter kinetics and frame rate while keeping the hidden activity fixed.

practice.task: Compare two synthetic indicator recordings of the same event train.
practice.success: Explains temporal blur and reports what cannot be inferred about exact spikes.
